description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of three models, Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, in two categories, MMAU and MMAR. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, with the model names listed below. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, marked at intervals of 10. Each model has two bars, one for MMAU (blue) and one for MMAR (purple), grouped together. The MMAU bars have values of approximately 49, 62, and 64 for Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, respectively, while the MMAR bars have values of around 30, 35, and 56 for the same models. The bars are grouped by model, with the MMAU bar appearing first, followed by the MMAR bar. The models are listed in a specific order, but are not sorted by their accuracy values. No bars are visually emphasized.
